q: Thouvenot's relative isomorphism theorem extends Ornstein's result. Two extensions T̃ of T and S̃ of S over isomorphic base (T ≅ S) are relatively isomorphic if they both have the relative:
opts: VWB property (very weak Bernoulli relative to the factor)
exp: Thouvenot's relative Ornstein: if T and S are isomorphic and T̃, S̃ are extensions satisfying the relative VWB property with the same relative entropy, then T̃ ≅ S̃ over the common factor. This is the main tool for proving isomorphism of geodesic flows and other systems.
